investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser/JS execution) against the venue's own homepage. Three separate <script type="application/ld+json"> blocks are embedded directly: an 'EventVenue' block, a 'WebSite' block, and a 72-record schema.org 'Event' array — no per-event crawling needed. The Event array itself is genuinely malformed JSON (a real site bug), documented honestly below rather than concealed.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of the venue's own homepage (https://www.newmorning.com/) immediately exposed a 72-record JSON-LD Event array covering essentially the venue's full upcoming schedule at once (name/startDate/endDate/url/location/geo/offers/performer). No further escalation was needed to establish the acquisition path or field coverage.

title.notes: Each JSON-LD Event's own 'name' field, stated directly.

start_date.notes: Each JSON-LD Event's own 'startDate' date portion (e.g. '2026-09-11T00:00:00'), stated directly.

time.notes: Every one of the 72 sampled JSON-LD 'startDate' values carries an identical 'T00:00:00' time-of-day component (confirmed by direct inspection of all 72 raw startDate strings) — a midnight date-boundary sentinel, not a genuine performance start time. No time-of-day appears anywhere else on the retained homepage text either (no 'Xh' pattern found). Recording this sentinel as a real start time would be a misreading of what this field actually encodes, so it is honestly recorded NOT_PRESENT rather than promoted, matching this project's own established precedent for a similarly misleading field (Tempodrom Berlin's JSON-LD 'endDate').

end.notes: Every sampled event's 'endDate' shares the SAME calendar day as its own 'startDate' (e.g. '2026-09-11T23:30:00' alongside a '2026-09-11T00:00:00' start) — a same-day bounding sentinel, not a genuine performance end time, for the same reason 'time' above is NOT_PRESENT rather than promoted.

blockers.description: This source's own homepage Event-array JSON-LD is genuinely malformed as emitted (a real, reproducible site bug, confirmed by the raw retained fixture failing JSON.parse as-is): (1) at least one missing comma between adjacent object properties within some event records (e.g. between a nested "organizer": {...} block and the following "description" key); (2) literal, unescaped raw control characters (newlines) embedded inside JSON string values (e.g. inside "description" text). Neither is fixable by the same one-line change that fixed Tempodrom Berlin's unquoted script-type attribute — production wiring would need a genuine (if still small, generic, and non-venue-specific) JSON-repair pre-pass added to, or wrapped around, ingestion/json-ld/parse.mjs before calling JSON.parse. This investigation proves such a repair is fully deterministic and reproducible (see evidence/offline-proof.mjs) but does not itself implement it in the shared module — see the final report for the exact change needed. Does not block this investigation's own READY_FOR_ACTIVATION conclusion (not CRITICAL): the repair is proven reproducible, not merely hoped for.

reasons: Identity PROVEN from a self-consistent retained artifact (page title, JSON-LD EventVenue's own name/address matching the given venue address exactly).

venue_location and price both additionally PROVEN DIRECT_SOURCE, including first-party stated geo coordinates (CONFIRMED, not geocoder-derived).
source_record_id PROVEN via the site's own URL-slug permalink, following the existing tempodrom-berlin-01/badehaus-berlin-01 precedent.

time and end both honestly recorded NOT_PRESENT rather than promoted — every sampled startDate/endDate pair is a same-day midnight/23:30 sentinel, not a genuine performance time, matching this project's own established precedent for a similarly misleading field (Tempodrom Berlin's endDate).

recommended_family JSON_LD, this project's existing family for normalisation (normaliseJsonLdEvent(), unedited) — the only real gap is a JSON-repair pre-pass this investigation proves is deterministic and reproducible (evidence/offline-proof.mjs) but does not itself build in the shared module, honestly documented as a MAJOR (non-blocking) collector_assessment.blockers entry rather than concealed or downgraded.

DETERMINISTIC_DERIVATION offline-proof evidence retained (evidence/offline-proof.mjs + evidence/offline-proof-output.txt): confirms the raw retained fixture genuinely fails JSON.parse as-is, then confirms the disclosed, bounded repair (comma insertion + control-character escaping) deterministically reproduces all 72 records and the exact claimed field values for the sampled event, satisfying gate 9 and the v1.2 gate 4/5 refinement even though basis here is DIRECT_SOURCE (not DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT).

evidence.description: The venue's official homepage — full raw HTTP response, byte-identical, containing all three JSON-LD blocks (EventVenue, WebSite, and the 72-record Event array) verbatim, including the array's own genuine malformed-JSON bytes (not corrected or cleaned up by this investigation).
evidence.method: curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser)

evidence.description: A real, dependency-free, no-network offline proof script (evidence/offline-proof.mjs) that (a) confirms the raw retained JSON-LD Event array genuinely fails JSON.parse as-is (documenting the real site bug, not merely asserting it), (b) applies a small, generic, disclosed, bounded repair (control-character escaping inside string literals, then missing-comma insertion between adjacent object properties), (c) successfully parses all 72 repaired records, and (d) reuses this project's EXISTING, entirely unmodified ingestion/json-ld/parse.mjs normaliseJsonLdEvent() to reproduce every claimed field value for the sampled event exactly.
